policy_metadata.policy_title: Laboratory – Serum Biomarker Testing for Multiple Sclerosis and Related Neurologic Diseases

sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. • Measurement of aquaporin-4 immunoglobulin G and myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein-immunoglobulin G using a serum indirect fluorescence assay (CPT code 86052, CPT code 86362) or fluorescence-activated cell sorting assay (CPT code 86053*, CPT code 86363*) IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals with any of the following conditions: – Blindness or vision loss – Demyelinating disease – Disease of spinal cord – Encephalitis – Erectile dysfunction after myelitis – Lesion on the brain, optic nerve or spinal cord – Myelitis – Neuritis – Neutrophilic cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) pleocytosis – Optic papillitis – Papilledema – White matter disease • Enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) testing for aquaporin-4 (CPT code 86051) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE for individuals with any of the following conditions: – Demyelinating disease – Disease of spinal cord – Encephalitis – Multiple sclerosis – Myelitis – Neuritis – Optic papillitis
